member.name: T:Meziantou.Framework.RelativeDate
member.summary: Represents a date and time that can be formatted as a human-readable relative time string (e.g., "2 hours ago", "in 3 days").
member.remarks:
This type provides localized relative date/time strings for multiple languages: Dutch, English, French, German, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Portuguese, Simplified Chinese, Spanish and Turkish. The default localization can be customized by setting .
Equality and ordering are defined over the instant alone. The time provider is display state: two instances that compare equal, and hash the same, can still render differently.

member.name: M:Meziantou.Framework.RelativeDate.ToString(System.String,System.IFormatProvider)
member.summary: Formats the relative date using the specified format and culture.
member.param: The format string. Only , an empty string and "G" are supported; the output does not vary between them.
An that supplies culture-specific formatting information, typically a . A provider that returns a from is also honored. When , is used.
member.remarks:
The method returns strings like:
"now" - for the current moment
"one second ago" / "in one second" - for ±1 second
"X seconds ago" / "in X seconds" - for <1 minute
"a minute ago" / "in a minute" - for 1-2 minutes
"X minutes ago" / "in X minutes" - for <45 minutes
"an hour ago" / "in an hour" - for 45-120 minutes
"X hours ago" / "in X hours" - for 2-24 hours
"yesterday" / "tomorrow" - for 24-48 hours
"X days ago" / "in X days" - for <30 days
"one month ago" / "in one month" - for 30-60 days
"X months ago" / "in X months" - for <365 days
"one year ago" / "in one year" - for 365-730 days
"X years ago" / "in X years" - for ≥730 days
